content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-22 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05161. Per the clinical indication note, the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. The note further states that, given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness. We request reconsideration of the CO-22 coordination-of-benefits determination and review of the documented clinical necessity for this service."}
